name: B10-0428/2026 (ECR) – The need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text:
This resolution is not a law. It is a request from some Members of the European Parliament for a common EU plan against Islamism and the Muslim Brotherhood network. It asks the Council to put the Muslim Brotherhood on the EU terrorist list, to stop EU money reaching linked groups, and to ban face veils in public. It also calls for expelling foreign Islamists and for closer cooperation between national intelligence services.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of demands, not a decision.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the Commission, Muslim groups and their funding.
- **What happens next:** It goes to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to act.
